tools.name: list_pins
tools.description: List logical pins 0-7 with mode, pulls, and level.

tools.name: configure_pins
tools.description: Configure one or more pins. Always pass pins (e.g. pins:[1]).

openDrain.description: Allowed for digitalOutput, digitalInputOutput, and pwmOutput

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: get_pin_levels
tools.description: Read digital levels for pins. Returns levels array in pins order.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: set_pin_levels
tools.description: Write digital level for one or more pins.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: pulse_pins
tools.description: Pulse one or more pins for width microseconds.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: get_pin_pwms
tools.description: Read PWM frequency and duty for pins (pwmOutput only).

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: set_pin_pwms
tools.description: Set PWM frequency and duty for pins (pwmOutput only).

frequency.description: Hz. Very low frequencies may be rejected.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: trace_pins
tools.description: Capture edge events on one or more pins.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: get_output_power_state
tools.description: Read 3v3 or 5v rail enable state. Overcurrent, overtemperature, or reverse-voltage turns the rail off and sets reason; the next enable clears it.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: set_output_power_state
tools.description: Set 3v3 or 5v rail enable state.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: list_uarts
tools.description: List UART ids with enable, baud, framing, encoding, and pins.

tools.name: configure_uart
tools.description: Configure one UART by id. When enable is true, at least one of pins.rx or pins.tx is required.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: uart_transmit
tools.description: Transmit data on a UART. data is a UTF-8 string when encoding is utf8, or an even-length hex string when encoding is byte.

data.description: UTF-8 text when encoding is utf8; even-length hex when encoding is byte.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: uart_receive
tools.description: Drain the UART receive buffer and return data using the configured encoding.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: uart_flush
tools.description: Discard the UART receive buffer without returning it.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: list_spis
tools.description: List SPI ids with enable, role, cpol, cpha, bitOrder, pins, and clockHz when role is master.

tools.name: configure_spi
tools.description: Configure one SPI controller by id. role is master or slave. cpol and cpha are each 0 or 1. bitOrder is msb or lsb. clockHz is required for master and must be omitted for slave. clk and cs are required when enable is true. mosi and miso may be null.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: spi_master_transceive
tools.description: Clock bytes on an enabled master. data is an even-length hex string of 0-255 bytes. Non-empty data requires pins.mosi. When pins.miso is unset, data in the result is "".

data.description: Even-length hexadecimal bytes. An empty string is zero bytes.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: spi_slave_receive
tools.description: Drain events from an enabled slave with pins.miso set. Each event has startTime, endTime, receive, and send. When the buffer is full, the oldest events are discarded.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: spi_slave_transmit
tools.description: Replace the slave response map. type is exact or prefix. Match exact first, then the longest prefix. An empty prefix matches every receive. Requires an enabled slave with pins.mosi set.

mosi.description: Even-length hexadecimal bytes. An empty string is zero bytes.

miso.description: Even-length hexadecimal bytes. An empty string is zero bytes.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: list_i2cs
tools.description: List I2C ids with enable, role, pullUp, addressBits, pins, clockHz and sclWaitUs when role is master, and address when role is slave.

tools.name: configure_i2c
tools.description: Configure one I2C controller by id. role is master or slave. pullUp and addressBits (7 or 10) are required. clockHz and sclWaitUs are required for master and must be omitted for slave. address is required for slave and must be omitted for master. sda and scl are required when enable is true.

pullUp.description: Weak internal pull-ups on sda and scl. External pull-ups are still recommended.

sclWaitUs.description: Master wait for slave SCL stretch, in microseconds. 0 uses the driver default.

pullUp.description: Weak internal pull-ups on sda and scl. External pull-ups are still recommended.

address.description: Slave address. Max 127 when addressBits is 7, max 1023 when addressBits is 10.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: i2c_master_transceive
tools.description: Transfer on an enabled master. address range follows bus addressBits (0-127 for 7, 0-1023 for 10). write is even-length hex (0-255 bytes). readLen is 0-255. timeoutMs is optional (default 1000, range 1-60000). Empty write with readLen 0 probes the address. write then read uses a repeated start.

address.description: Device address. Max 127 when bus addressBits is 7, max 1023 when addressBits is 10.

write.description: Even-length hexadecimal bytes. An empty string is zero bytes.

timeoutMs.description: Transfer wait timeout in milliseconds. Default 1000 when omitted.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: i2c_slave_receive
tools.description: Drain events from an enabled slave. Each event has startTime, endTime, receive, and send. When the buffer is full, the oldest events are discarded.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: i2c_slave_transmit
tools.description: Replace the slave response map. type is exact or prefix. Match exact first, then the longest prefix. An empty prefix matches every receive. Requires an enabled slave.

receive.description: Even-length hexadecimal bytes. An empty string is zero bytes.

send.description: Even-length hexadecimal bytes. An empty string is zero bytes.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.

tools.name: create_lock
tools.description: Create a lock. Each resource is type pin with pins, type power with rails, type uart with ids, type spi with ids, or type i2c with ids.

tools.name: renew_lock
tools.description: Renew a lock TTL by id.

tools.name: delete_lock
tools.description: Delete a lock by id (idempotent).

tools.name: play_buzzer
tools.description: Play a Morse-style sequence on the onboard buzzer and wait until it finishes. `.` is a short beep, `-` is a long beep, space is an extra gap. One sequence at a time.

sequence.description: Morse-style pattern. `.` short, `-` long, space extra gap.

tools.name: get_dap_status
tools.description: Read the CMSIS-DAP status. prompt explains how to connect. port and ip are the address.

tools.name: configure_dap
tools.description: Configure CMSIS-DAP. When enable is true, pins.swclk and pins.swdio are required and the TCP service starts. pins.nreset may be null.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the pins.

tools.name: get_cloud_status
tools.description: Return whether the device is connected and authenticated to the cloud relay, the public landingPageUrl (empty when cloud relay is disabled), and a reason when not connected.

tools.name: get_system_info
tools.description: Return Authentication Digest, firmware version, and compiled date from the running image header.

tools.name: check_system_ota
tools.description: Check the published update manifest for a newer firmware image for this device. Side-effect-free; does not store the result. When an update is available, returns version, changelog, url, and sha256 for upgrade_system_ota.

tools.name: get_system_ota
tools.description: Return live firmware update status: idle, upgrading, or failed (with optional progressPercent and reason). Does not include last check results.

tools.name: upgrade_system_ota
tools.description: Start a background firmware upgrade. Requires url and sha256 from check_system_ota. Verifies the image digest before writing. Non-system APIs return 503 while upgrading. Device reboots on success.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the app firmware image

sha256.description: Expected app image digest (64 hex chars)

tools.name: run_script
tools.description:
Run a sandboxed Lua 5.4 script on-device. The script can call the same pin/power/UART/SPI/lock tools as MCP (not run_script). Optional maxCalls and timeout (microseconds) must not exceed firmware ceilings. One script at a time.

Lua 5.4. Allowed libraries: base, table, string, math, utf8. require, dofile, loadfile, load, and collectgarbage are nil. No io, os, package, debug, or coroutine.

Each tool is a global that takes one argument table with the same keys as MCP (always pass pins even for one pin). JSON arrays become 1-based Lua tables. sleep(us) delays in microseconds and counts toward timeout, not maxCalls. print() is captured as output. The first return value is result (JSON).

Errors raise a table {reason="..."}. Catch with pcall and read err.reason. Uncaught errors fail the request with that reason; print output is discarded.

Catchable with pcall:
- Tool failure: system sentence (no "The script reported" prefix), e.g. pin/lock/mode errors
- error("msg"): "The script reported an error: msg. Catch it with pcall or fix the script."
- error() or error(""): "The script called error with no message. Catch it with pcall or fix the script."

Not catchable (abort the whole run even if pcall returns):
- timeout: "Script exceeded timeout."
- maxCalls: "Script exceeded maxCalls."
- out of memory: "Script ran out of memory."
- syntax or uncaught Lua runtime: "The script failed: <message>. Catch it with pcall or fix the script."

Example:
configure_pins{pins={0}, mode="digitalOutput", pullUp=false, pullDown=false}
set_pin_levels{pins={0}, level=1}
sleep(5000)
local r = get_pin_levels{pins={0}}
print("level", r.levels[1])
return r

Error handling:
local ok, err = pcall(function()
  set_pin_levels{pins={0}, level=1}
end)
if not ok then
  return {ok=false, reason=err.reason}
end

script.description: Lua 5.4 source. Allowed libraries: base, table, string, math, utf8.

lockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource.
